claim_scope: Bounded exploratory comparison of two already-trained enriched decoders on the declared natural-source panel. Conclusions are limited to these fitted states, domains, target trajectories, source ranges, and 128-token clips.

provenance.fixture_scope: Already-opened fixture only; two records per cell, two methods; no new TRR6 truth or timing claim.
provenance.method_provenance_note: The root method_freeze.json binds the selected states; fresh_confirmation_v1/method_registration.json is the published executable registration. Both are read-only inputs.
provenance.readiness: Decision rules reviewed by root; plan remains unselected and unfrozen until eligibility/resource preflight permits the one sample-size revision.

methods.rule: joint affine path plus zero-initialized causal H_0..H_i attention correction; repaired cosine/QK-normalized implementation
joint affine path plus trained current-position-only diagonal attention correction

comparison.primary_contrast: enriched causal context versus enriched trained diagonal positionwise control
comparison.deduplication: causal-versus-selected-positionwise is the same contrast as causal-versus-diagonal for this task and is not a second endpoint or corroborating analysis
comparison.pairing_unit: one natural source record; the identical source is evaluated under public_base and synthetic-LoRA targets
comparison.source_resampling: Use one deterministic source-resample schedule within each domain for both target conditions and both methods; do not multiply target-wise probabilities or assume target independence.

panel.source_selection: Use the published natural sampling order (seed 5005), source formatting and existing ranges. Apply all accessible fitting/validation/opened/duplicate exclusions and available P04 opaque hashes before selecting the first 1536 eligible records per domain. No wrappers, balancing, or range extension.
panel.prediction_rows: one source record at a time after stored H128 is prepared
panel.source_pairing: 3,072 unique sources: 1,536 per domain, each paired across public_base and public_lora_2601. Four cells contain 6,144 source-target records per method, not 6,144 independent sources.
panel.initial_source_accounting: At 1024 records/domain: 2048 unique natural source records across two domains and 4096 paired source-target evaluations (two target conditions).

sample_size_revision.rationale: At the published Finance public-base discordance rates (gain 5/128, loss 4/128), the registered exact-margin exclusion probability is approximately 0.977 at n=1536 versus 0.805 at n=1024. The 50% sample increase is feasible within existing source ranges and bounded chunk geometry. These are conditional IID multinomial planning scenarios, not guaranteed power on the new natural panel.
sample_size_revision.limitations: Rates are multinomial planning scenarios from published TRR5 paired events. Cross-target dependence is retained through paired-pattern bounds/simulation; no product of marginal probabilities is a guaranteed joint claim.
sample_size_revision.source_accounting: At 1536 records/domain: 3072 unique natural source records across two domains and 6144 paired source-target evaluations (two target conditions); these are not 4096 independent observations.

token.method: paired source-record bootstrap of the micro correct/scored token-rate difference
token.coverage: Registered exploratory practical-benefit bounds use paired bootstrap quantiles with approximate coverage, not a finite-sample exact guarantee.

events.causal_only: causal exact and diagonal not exact; beneficial gain event
events.positionwise_only: diagonal exact and causal not exact; harmful loss event

exact_record.counts: Report all four mutually exclusive counts per domain and target; they must sum to the paired source count.
exact_record.coverage: Each Clopper-Pearson endpoint has an exact marginal one-sided guarantee under its binomial marginal; the retained allocation is conservative for the directional family.

multiplicity.directional_family: 4 cells x 2 outcomes (token, exact) x 2 directions (lower support/harm and upper exclusion) = 16 directional bounds
multiplicity.interpretation: Support and exclusion use the same predeclared directional family; do not add a second causal-versus-selected-positionwise family.

uncertainty.descriptive_reporting: Report paired 95% source-bootstrap intervals for token deltas and exact-record deltas/gain-loss rates. Descriptive intervals and a point estimate reaching a margin do not by themselves support a practical claim.

decision_rules.quality_unit: Every one of the four domain/target cells is evaluated separately; support needs at least one prespecified cell/outcome endpoint and harm must be addressed in all remaining endpoints. No pooled headline can satisfy a cell-level rule.
decision_rules.candidate_useful: A descriptive point estimate reaches +0.5 pp token or +5 pp exact and costs are reported. This is a candidate signal only, not positive-evidence power.
decision_rules.supported_practical_context_gain: Support a practical context gain when at least one prespecified cell has a lower practical bound reaching its registered margin (+0.5 pp token OR +5 pp exact), every remaining cell/outcome lower bound is at least its retained harm limit (-0.5 pp token or -5 pp exact), and the cost qualification is reported. State exactly which endpoint supports the claim; this is a cell/outcome-scoped result, not a universal four-cell benefit claim.
decision_rules.practical_exclusion_positionwise: Classify exclusion only when, in all four cells, the token upper practical bound is strictly below +0.5 pp AND the exact upper practical bound U_CP(g)-L_CP(h) is strictly below +5 pp. Do not add a lower-bound harm condition: if causal is worse, that strengthens the positionwise default; if the sign remains uncertain, report it as uncertainty.
decision_rules.material_harm: Call evidence of material harm only when an upper practical bound is strictly below the negative harm margin (token U < -0.5 pp OR exact U < -5 pp) in a cell. A lower bound below -margin alone means harm has not been excluded; it is not evidence of harm.
decision_rules.inconclusive: If neither the scoped support rule nor the all-four-cell exclusion rule holds, classify the context comparison as inconclusive. Distinguish harm_not_excluded from evidence_of_material_harm and state the remaining interval and decision relevance.
decision_rules.cost_qualification: Report warmed runtime ratio and retained-state preparation/training cost separately. The cost rule is runtime ratio <=1.25 and historical training/preparation ratio <=2 when that ratio is available; no new training is permitted. Missing historical cost does not block quality inference, but a final cost-based recommendation must state cost_unqualified.
decision_rules.quality_support_without_cost: Quality inference may be reported when the support rule holds even if historical preparation/training cost is unavailable; mark cost_unqualified and withhold a final cost-based recommendation until the cost rule is qualified.
decision_rules.harm_not_excluded: If a lower bound is below the negative harm margin but its upper bound is not below that margin, label harm_not_excluded and make the support claim inconclusive for the affected endpoint.
decision_rules.cost_qualified_support: A support result is cost-qualified only when warmed runtime ratio <=1.25 and the available retained preparation/training ratio <=2. If the historical preparation/training ratio is unavailable because no new training is run, report the quality support as cost_unqualified rather than silently treating it as qualified; the quality bounds remain valid.

truth_gate.required_before_truth: Complete all eight cell-method prediction outputs (four cells x two methods), stored H128/output identity, one warmup and one measured timing record per source row with exact repeat IDs, frozen source/observation/input/state/code hashes, complete manifest and freeze receipt.
order: verify both frozen states and executable source commit
verify all eight prediction artifacts, geometry, IDs, and timing receipts
freeze the complete matrix and rehash it
score all cells without partial result exposure
truth_gate.fail_closed: Any missing, changed, incomplete, untimed, or partially scored artifact raises before the truth loader is invoked. The scorer must not read or hash evaluator truth during this gate.

reporting.absolute_quality: Absolute exact recovery is the declared all-127-post-BOS-token clip rate; a relative context result does not establish good reconstruction quality.
reporting.joint_claims: If a joint statement across target conditions or domains is made, state the observed paired-pattern calculation or explicit dependence bound; do not assume independent targets or multiply marginal exclusion probabilities.

exclusion_limitations: P04 target-fit disjointness cannot be certified from the approved aggregate exchange because per-record IDs, source ranges, and replay sequence hashes are unavailable.

Available P04 source/sequence hashes are applied. Unavailable target-fit256 individual identities/ranges and replay sequence hashes prevent a complete cross-study disjointness certificate. No underlying private P04 ledgers were opened.

execution_preflight.geometry_qualification: Complete the largest chunk8 qualification on already-opened material before releasing main capture/prediction execution. Preserve one-record decoder numerical semantics.
execution_preflight.cost_projection: 50% more records than proposed1024. Prior512source-target capture inner7.57s scales to about91s for6144; prior standalone~5ms per prediction implies about123s for two methods times one warmup+one measured call. Startup, hashing and I/O are additional; use generous bounded run limits and live guards. These are planning estimates, not measured TRR6 costs.
